RESIDENTIAL TENANCY AGREEMENT (BENGALURU)
This agreement is made between Mr. Ramesh Sharma (Lessor) and Mr. Ankit Kumar (Lessee) for Flat 302 Indiranagar Bengaluru.
Monthly Rent: ₹25,000 payable on or before 5th of each month.
Refundable Security Deposit: ₹1,50,000 to be returned within 45 days of termination subject to 1 month rent painting deduction.
Lock-in Period: 6 months. Notice Period: 60 days written notice required thereafter.
Jurisdiction: Courts at Bengaluru.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have set their signatures below.
